newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HUD's Cisneros says to decide soon on job.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HUD's Cisneros says to decide soon on job.

text.p: Housing Secretary Henry Cisneros said Thursday he would make a decision shortly on whether he will stay on as a member of President Clinton's Cabinet.
Asked when he might make the decision about his job, Cisneros told reporters: "I hope within the next hours, maybe the next day or so."
Cisneros said a key deciding factor would be whether he could afford, in financial terms, to stay on.
"I've been wrestling with this question about whether or not I could afford to stay," he said.
The White House has said the well-liked Cisneros has had discussions with top officials about his future but that no decision has been made. Cisneros has long been expected to leave his position.
